title: A portrait for work from your own photo
description: Fix the background, the light and the crop while keeping control over changes to the face.

blocks.text: A work profile needs a usable portrait made from your own shot. The background, the light or a stray lock of hair may be in the way; changing the shape of the face is not required for that.

quote.text: Used very quickly to clean up a Headshot for work/Linkedin. Only wish I could have touched up fluy away hairs / smoothed out hair but there were limited options with hair. Everything else worked great and was a breeze

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

The crop and the background are chosen first, then local corrections become available. You can check the hair and the edges of the clothing close up, compare the face with the original and save several sizes for different profiles.
Where the idea has an advantage

This scenario already fits within the capabilities of an ordinary editor. A separate product is worth testing on how fast it prepares a usable file and how clear its controls are, not on a promise to make a person automatically look “more professional”.
